lines.text: Your AI model is not your agent. On its own, it's just a brain.
It can think. But it forgets everything when the chat ends. It can't open your files. It can't check its own work.
What turns it into an agent is the layer around it. The harness. It has four parts.
Tools: so it can do things, not just talk.
Permissions: so it only acts where you say.
Verification: so it checks its work before calling it done.
Here's what most people miss. Models come and go. The model is raw intelligence. Every bit of customization, your way of working, lives in the harness.
And the harness isn't a robot standing apart from you. You wear it, like a second cortex. Your memory. Your rules. Your files.
That's Augmented intelligence. And because it's yours, it should live with you. Owned by you.
